tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background. True black in Operations — the map and telemetry read against nothing. Caliche paper in Paper, used for printed research and the press kit.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels and cards that sit on `ground`. Separated from `ground` by `hairline`, not by shade alone.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, popovers, the active item in a list. Body copy on this surface uses `ink` or `ink-muted`, never `ink-faint`.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Inputs, code blocks, the well behind a map. Never holds text directly — put a `surface` panel inside it.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: 1px rules between readout groups and table rows. Decorative only — it carries no meaning and does not meet 3:1, so never use it as the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Default control border on `ground` and `surface` (3.6:1 dark, 3.5:1 light). On `surface-raised` step up to `border-strong`.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Borders on `surface-raised`, and any border that must survive a projector or a cockpit screen in daylight.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and numerals on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (19.6:1 dark, 16.7:1 light). Cool white, not pure white — it sits beside cyan telemetry without going warm.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Field labels, units, secondary copy on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (7.4:1 dark, 7.4:1 light).

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Timestamps, source attributions, disabled text on `ground` and `surface` only (4.7:1 dark, 4.8:1 light). Drops below 4.5:1 on `surface-raised` — use `ink-muted` there.

tokens.name: ink-inverse
tokens.usage: Text and glyphs sitting on a solid `verdigris-bright` or `caliche` fill (10.6:1 and better).

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: The brand green. Large fields: the primary button, the mark's band at rest, a full-bleed section. `ink` reads on it at 7.1:1 — it is a fill, never text.

tokens.name: verdigris-deep
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds behind `verdigris-bright` text — a selected row, a pull quote, the hovered primary button. Same value in both themes.

tokens.name: verdigris-bright
tokens.usage: Links, the active mark, accent numerals on `ground`, `surface` and `surface-raised` (10.6:1 dark, 6.7:1 light). The only green that may be set as text.

tokens.name: on-verdigris
tokens.usage: Text on a solid `verdigris` fill (7.1:1 dark, 9.5:1 light).

tokens.name: hygro
tokens.usage: Reserved for operational surfaces. The company site does not use it; on a dark ground it is the same value as `verdigris-bright`.

tokens.name: caliche
tokens.usage: The dry-ground accent: rule above a research abstract, print covers, the Texas-soil half of the brand. Large text and marks only (10.6:1 dark, 4.5:1 light).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring, offset 2px. Meets 3:1 on every surface in both themes (8.8:1 and better).

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The wordmark and the one statement at the top of a page. Never two of these on a screen.

styles.name: display-l
styles.sample: We fly the clouds that make rain.
styles.usage: Section openers on the site and the title slide of a briefing.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Page titles inside the product and paper titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Panel headings — the 'Radar', 'Cloud', 'Environment' rank in a readout stack.

styles.name: subheading
styles.usage: Uppercase group headers above a set of readouts. Set in `ink-muted`.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Petrichor operates from Austin under a Texas Weather Modification licence.
styles.usage: Default running copy. Keep measures near 65 characters.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Captions, help text, table cells that are not numbers.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chip and button text, axis labels. Always uppercase.

styles.name: data-l
styles.usage: The single number a screen exists to show. Tabular figures.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Every value in a readout row. Tabular figures so columns of altitudes align.

styles.name: coord
styles.usage: Coordinates, tail numbers, flare serials, run identifiers.

styles.name: research-title
styles.sample: Hygroscopic seeding yield over the Edwards Plateau
styles.usage: Paper and technical-note titles in the research series.

styles.name: research-body
styles.sample: Across 41 randomised cases, the seeded cells produced a mean rain volume 14% above control.
styles.usage: The body of anything Petrichor publishes. Serif marks the difference between a claim we have evidence for and product copy.

styles.name: research-note
styles.usage: Footnotes, figure captions and the status line under a preprint.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a value and its unit; chip border inset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip padding-block; gap between stacked readout rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Chip padding-inline; button padding-block.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: The base step. Panel padding, gap between label and value column.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between readout groups inside a panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels; the sounding pitch in the mark and cover.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; space above a section heading.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Space between major page sections and around the cover blocks.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The default. Panels, tables, map frames and inputs are square — the system is an instrument, not a consumer app.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons and the few controls that need to read as pressable.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Popovers, tooltips, the flare-load diagram.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status chips only. A pill in this system always means a state, never a category.

shadow.note: One shadow. Elevation in Operations comes from borders, not from light.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Popovers and menus that float over the map. Nothing else casts a shadow.
